summary.text: Bishop Davidson is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 130 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He founded Pelion Learning and chairs the Joint Committee on Tax Policy.

paragraphs.text: Davidson was born in Chesapeake, Virginia, and graduated from Republic High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in history and classics from the University of Missouri in 2016.
His career experience includes working with the Intercollegiate Studies Institute and founding Pelion Learning.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was vice chair of the Budget Committee and chair of the Joint Committee on Tax Policy, and was also assigned to the Emerging Issues Committee and the Joint Committee on Education.
